subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Reliable
solution:
The correct answer is "**Stable**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Reliable: **consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Dishonest: **behaving or prone to behave in an untrustworthy, deceitful, or insincere way.
 
• **False: **not according to truth or fact; incorrect.
 
• **Stable: **not likely to change or fail; firmly established.
 
• **Weak: **lacking the power to perform physically demanding tasks; having little physical strength or energy.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**stable**" is the synonym for "reliable".
 
 
• **Example**: *Both Shri and Amit are in a **stable **__relationship.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word.
 
• **Reliable:**** **गुणवत्ता या प्रदर्शन में लगातार अच्छा; भरोसा करने में सक्षम।
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Dishonest:**** **अविश्वसनीय, धोखेबाज या कपटी तरीके से व्यवहार करना या व्यवहार करना।
 
• **False:**सत्य या तथ्य के अनुसार नहीं; गलत।
 
• **Stable:**बदलने या विफल होने की संभावना नहीं है; मज़बूती से स्थापित।
 
• **Weak:**शारीरिक रूप से मांग वाले कार्यों को करने की शक्ति की कमी; कम शारीरिक शक्ति या ऊर्जा होना।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**stable**" is the synonym for "reliable".
